$comment: The scan failure + issue policy (issue #715). `fail_on` is what a scheduled or manually dispatched run fails the pipeline on; `pr_fail_on` is the narrower set a pull_request run enforces, so a pre-existing High without a fix cannot red every PR in the repository; `issue_severities` is what `make security-issues` (#716) turns into a tagged issue. `require_fix` restricts all three to findings the scanner says have a fixed version.
